info.name: P09 — Real Estate Portal | Complete ordered demo and failure cases
info.description: Import P09.local.postman_environment.json, set adminEmail/adminPassword to your seeded admin, select that environment, and run all folders in order. The collection generates unique users and captures IDs/JWTs automatically. Use a dedicated demo database; records are intentionally retained for inspection. Every request has automated assertions. Secrets are blank in exports.
